release.content: pubkit 0.24.2 was released on 2026-11-01 from commit f5c49c6f0149cd4ec05a49d3dc73dc39a37615a3 with these changes.

rows: pubkit protect --check and the board no longer report a difference because a read-only token can't see a ruleset's bypass_actors, which GitHub hides from it.

pubkit state --check refuses a repository with protect on whose block requires a check it hasn't reported on its default branch or recent pull requests, since nothing could merge there. It says nothing when it can't read them.
